Configuration

Example Tool reads its settings from a file called tool.toml in the project folder, or from the environment when the file is not there. This page lists every setting and what it does.

Settings

Each setting has a default that works for most projects; change only what you need and keep the rest as it is.

[build]
jobs = 4

Inline math such as x=2x=2x=2 stays as MathML.
